usedFor: AnnounceKit holds product updates and subscribers, and Calendly receives a booking link from “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber Added” in AnnounceKit, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber is an interested reader, and the action creates a booking link ready to offer them.

watchOut: “New Subscriber Added” is polling, so the booking link is created after a scheduled check, not at sign-up.
